name: Dermatologist
description: The specialists who treat skin problems are called dermatologists or skin specialists.

name: ENT Specialist
description: Specialists who diagnose and treat diseases of the ear, nose, and throat.

name: Gynecologist
description: Gynecologists are those specialists that treat women reproductive issues & child birth.

name: Urologist
description: Urologists are specialist who diagnose, treat and manage conditions that affect reproductive and bladder health in men.

name: Neurologist
description: Doctors who visualize the brain and nervous system to diagnose and treat neurological disorders.

name: Orthopedic Surgeon
description: Specialists focused on injuries and diseases affecting the musculoskeletal system.

name: Gastroenterologist
description: Doctors who specialize in the digestive system and its disorders.

name: Dentist
description: Medical professionals who diagnose and treat problems with patients' teeth, gums, and related parts of the mouth.

name: Obesity Specialist
description: Medical experts who help patients manage and reduce obesity through various treatments.

name: Eye Specialist
description: Doctors who specialize in eye and vision care, including treating eye diseases.

name: Child Specialist
description: Doctors specializing in the health and medical care of infants, children, and adolescents.
